WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN n.business_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2;
SELECT fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 'dup_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS v FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (o.web_order_id IS NULL OR o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL OR o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_total', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_wb_lines_not_900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_of_web_lines_not_in_900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key WHERE fs.store_id=900 AND rs.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_900_of_nonweb_lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key WHERE fs.store_id<>900 AND rs.store_id=900;

WITH wd AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period AS per, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dd
    WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
),
rets AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period AS per,
           SUM(CASE WHEN rs.store_id=900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS ret_900,
           SUM(CASE WHEN rs.store_id<>900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS ret_instore_of_web
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
    WHERE fs.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
),
rpt AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period AS per, SUM(net_sales) AS rpt_net, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, SUM(returns_net) AS rpt_ret
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.business_date
    WHERE x.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.per, s.gross_sales, s.test_sales, r.ret_900, r.ret_instore_of_web, p.rpt_net, p.rpt_before, p.rpt_ret
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING(per) LEFT JOIN rpt p USING(per) ORDER BY 1;
